segments.text: Papertoslides instantly transforms your research papers and technical documents into slide decks and posters with just
one click. It supports PDFs, word files, even markdown, all processed together in one workflow with its ragpowered content
extraction, result, and insight is captured accurately and linked back to the original source so nothing gets lost. You can choose professional themes
or even describe your own design in plain language for custom styling.
